content: कनिष्ठ {%a.%} (Superl. of अल्प or युवन्) .²1 The smallest, least. .²2 The youngest; पुत्र एषामुतैषां ज्येष्ठ उत वा कनिष्ठः <ls>Rv. 10. 8. 28</ls>. .²3 Lower. .²4 Having the feet downwards. .{@-ष्ठः@} <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva. .{@-ष्ठा@} .²1 The little finger. .²2 A kind of heroine. .²3 The wife of a younger brother. .²4 A younger wife, one married later (than another); पुत्रः कनिष्ठो ज्येष्टायां कनिष्टायां च पूर्वजः <ls>Ms. 9. 122</ls>.
